insights.one_liner: Binance is a global crypto exchange with an English-language compliance role in Amsterdam, but it is not a recognised visa sponsor and faces EU licensing scrutiny.

culture.text: Binance describes itself as a global blockchain and digital-asset technology company operating across many jurisdictions.

open.text: Binance is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.

growth.text: Binance launched an AI suite with three products for users and developers.

worth_knowing.text: The EU questioned Binance over continuing operations in Europe despite an order to wind down, reportedly serving EU customers without a MiCA licence.
Dutch tech site Tweakers reported the EU is investigating Binance for serving European customers without a licence.
